text:
pair(2 + 3, 4 * 5)  evaluates to pair(5, 20)
fst(pair(5, 20))    evaluates to 5
snd(pair(5, 20))    evaluates to 20

fst(pair(1, 1 / 0)) raises ZeroDivisionError
fst(7)             raises TypeError
